title: Ginsenosides alleviate the progression of hepatic fibrosis by targeting the liver circadian clock gene CLOCK.
authors: Yu, Jiawen; Qian, Chunmei; Que, Renye; Zhou, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷通过靶向肝脏生物钟基因CLOCK缓解肝纤维化，虽含分子对接但核心为药理与病理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Hepatic fibrosis (HF) serves as a critical pathological process underlying the progression of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Despite its clinical relevance, effective anti‑fibrotic therapies remain scarce. Although total ginsenosides (GSS) can ameliorate hepatic oxidative damage and attenuate the development of HF, the molecular mechanism mediating their anti‑fibrotic effects remains incompletely elucidated. Notably, circadian clock gene dysregulation is associated with hepatic metabolic dyshomeostasis and the fibrotic process. As a core circadian gene in the liver, clock circadian regulator (CLOCK) serves a role in the progression of fibrosis. The present study hypothesized that GSS may exert anti‑fibrotic effects by restoring hepatic circadian rhythmicity through circadian clock‑dependent pathways. Using a well‑established carbon tetrachloride‑induced murine model of HF in C57BL/6 mice, GSS was administered intraperitoneally at graded doses of 50, 100 and 200 mg/kg. Subsequently, serum and liver tissues were collected from mice for histopathological examination. Furthermore, the expression levels of fibrotic markers (alpha‑smooth muscle actin and collagen type 1) and circadian rhythm genes [CLOCK, basic helix‑loop‑helix ARNT‑like 1, cryptochrome (CRY)1, CRY2, period circadian protein homolog (PER)1 and PER2 were assessed. At the cellular level, LX‑2 hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) were activated with TGF‑beta1 and treated with GSS, after which, RNA sequencing was performed on GSS‑treated cells. In addition, the CLOCK inhibitor (CLK8) was used for in vitro experiments. The results of the present study revealed that GSS intervention effectively reversed the dysregulation of circadian gene expression and alleviated the progression of fibrosis. Molecular docking analysis further supported the interaction between GSS active components and the CLOCK protein. Thus, the current study focused on GSS and explored its role in ameliorating HF through regulation of the core circadian gene CLOCK. Collectively, the findings demonstrated that GSS may alleviate HF by rescuing circadian clock‑driven circadian homeostasis in hepatocytes and HSCs, thereby providing mechanistic insight into traditional Chinese medicine‑based interventions and identifying CLOCK as a druggable node for fibrosis therapy.
abstract_zh: 肝纤维化（HF）是肝硬化及肝细胞癌进展中的关键病理过程。尽管其具有临床重要性，有效的抗纤维化治疗手段仍然匮乏。虽然总人参皂苷（GSS）能够改善肝脏氧化损伤并减缓HF的发展，但其介导抗纤维化效应的分子机制尚未完全阐明。值得注意的是，昼夜节律时钟基因的失调与肝脏代谢稳态失衡及纤维化过程相关。作为肝脏中的核心昼夜节律基因，时钟昼夜节律调节因子（CLOCK）在纤维化进展中发挥作用。本研究假设GSS可能通过昼夜节律时钟依赖性通路恢复肝脏昼夜节律性，从而发挥抗纤维化作用。利用在C57BL/6小鼠中建立的成熟四氯化碳诱导HF模型，以50、100和200 mg/kg的梯度剂量腹腔注射GSS。随后，收集小鼠血清和肝组织进行组织病理学检查。此外，评估了纤维化标志物（α-平滑肌肌动蛋白和I型胶原）及昼夜节律基因[CLOCK、碱性螺旋-环-螺旋ARNT样蛋白1、隐花色素（CRY）1、CRY2、周期昼夜节律蛋白同源物（PER）1和PER2]的表达水平。在细胞水平上，用TGF-β1激活LX-2肝星状细胞（HSCs）并给予GSS处理，随后对GSS处理的细胞进行RNA测序。此外，使用CLOCK抑制剂（CLK8）进行体外实验。本研究结果显示，GSS干预有效逆转了昼夜节律基因表达的失调，并减缓了纤维化进展。分子对接分析进一步支持了GSS活性成分与CLOCK蛋白之间的相互作用。因此，本研究聚焦于GSS，探讨其通过调控核心昼夜节律基因CLOCK改善HF的作用。总体而言，研究结果表明，GSS可能通过恢复肝细胞和HSCs中昼夜节律时钟驱动的昼夜节律稳态来缓解HF，从而为基于中药的干预提供机制性见解，并将CLOCK确定为纤维化治疗的可药物靶点。
